column1: # Commands of the extension package "protocol-demo". Its package.toml says protocol = [1]: the core runs demo.py through the command protocol
# and renders result.data (a list = TSV lines, an object = key TAB value, - for an empty cell); timeout:<seconds> is a flag of a row.

column5: say hello through the command protocol: hs ext protocol-demo hello [name]
column6: einmal Hallo über das Befehlsprotokoll sagen: hs ext protocol-demo hello [Name]

column5: three demo rows: name, size, note (- = none)
column6: drei Beispielzeilen: Name, Größe, Notiz (- = keine)

column5: sleeps longer than its timeout of 2 seconds: the core stops it with exit 124
column6: schläft länger als sein Zeitlimit von 2 Sekunden: der Kern bricht ab (Exit 124)
